dedupe_keys.name: functional map of the world fmow satellite image dataset of facility and land use types

description: Functional Map of the World is a large satellite image dataset built for the IARPA fMoW challenge to classify the function of buildings and land use from imagery, released in two versions: fMoW-full with 4-band and 8-band multispectral TIFF images (about 3.5 TB) and fMoW-rgb converted to JPEG (about 200 GB). Images are labelled with bounding boxes into several dozen categories that include airports and terminals, dams, electric substations, factories or power plants, fire stations, flooded roads, gas stations, educational institutions, hospitals, police stations, shopping malls, stadiums and other facility types, with metadata per image and manifests listing all files; the challenge has ended but the data remain on AWS, while the BitTorrent route is deprecated. Coverage: worldwide sample of sites. Access: free from the SpaceNet AWS bucket with the AWS CLI. Licence: the fMoW Challenge Public License from DigitalGlobe Intelligence Solutions, which states that algorithms trained on the data are not adapted material. Caveats: imagery is from the mid-2010s and categories sample sites, not map complete inventories. Simulation uses: training models that recognise critical facilities and building functions from imagery to fill exposure inventories. Related records: OpenFACADES and the Giga AI school mapping model.
